title: How Does Negative Energy Affect You ?
description:
Every inconvenience — from a bad day at work to family fights — gets blamed on “negative energy.” Astrology, Vastu, feng shui, and Instagram reels are filled with claims that negative energy causes illness, loan problems, failed exams, and bad luck. But what is this “energy” really?

In this video, Pale Blue Thoughts breaks down the pseudoscience of negative energy. We examine how charlatans use scientific jargon to sound credible, how astrologers, Vastu consultants, numerologists, and tarot readers twist the meaning of “negative” and “energy,” and why remedies like chilli-lemon rituals, salt sprinkling, black stones, and incense are scams.

Then we turn to real science: what energy in physics actually means, from joules, work, and potential energy to the laws of thermodynamics. We explain why gravitational potential energy can be negative in physics — but that has nothing to do with your aunt’s “bad vibes.”

If you’ve searched for what is negative energy, negative energy debunked, Vastu negative energy explained, physics vs pseudoscience energy, or astrology scam exposed, this video clears the fog with science and common sense. The only real “energy” worth worrying about is the one that powers your brain.

Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share — hype this video so it reaches more people and cuts through the nonsense!
